business.name: Cali Cultural Tours
business.description: Discover Cali, Colombia with us. Food tours, salsa experiences, nature adventures & more.
business.tagline: Showing Cali's true soul one tour at a time

hero.heading: Cali is soul. Book the real thing.
hero.subheading: Experience authentic Colombian culture with us. Personalised tours, local secrets, and unforgettable memories.

about.heading: Heritage, Passion & Local Soul
paragraphs: We are Cali Cultural Tours, born and raised in the heart of Cali. Since 2022, we've dedicated our lives to sharing the vibrant spirit of our home with the world.
Tourism isn't just our job; it's our bridge to global cultures. We believe that the best way to know a city is through its people and its food.
Cali is COOLtural. Let us show you why.

tours.title: Street Food Tour in Cali
tours.description: Taste authentic Colombian street food in Cali while exploring the historic city center and the stories behind some of the city's most iconic streets and landmarks.
tours.highlight: Come hungry and ready to eat! You will be full by the end of the tour.
tours.languages: Guides available in English, Spanish & Portuguese
tours.meeting_point: Subway Sandwich store on Boulevard del Río (Calle 8 crossing)
included: Fritanga stop (fried snacks) empanadas, marranitas, aborrajados, papa rellena.
Bakery stop: pandebono, buñuelos, empanada de cambray, almojábana, hot coffee.
Shaved ice with fruits stop: cholado, raspado, lulada, champús and more.
not_included: More than 3 items per person per stop (promise you will be full!)
itinerary: Boulevard del Río — Cali's most iconic riverside walk. Local vendors, street art, and city life; the perfect introduction to the rhythm of the city.
Café Boulevard — We will show you one of the most active spots in the city; a place where locals gather to dance, socialize, and enjoy salsa music.
Fritanga Los Paisas — Our first food stop is hearty and warm, with plenty of fried snacks to choose from.
La Curva Bar — Decorated with a mural of 3 of the most legendary salsa musicians, because this tour is much more than just food; it's a cultural experience.
La Calle del Sabor — calle de la salsa? salsa street? calle del sabor? What's the difference? Let us show you.
BuoPan — Second food stop to choose amongst different local breads, or even a hot coffee.
Plaza Cayzedo — a historical stop at what used to be Cali's main square.
Historical Downtown — Teatro Jorge Isaacs, Edificio Coltabaco, Parque de los Poetas, Iglesia La Ermita, Puente Ortiz and some modern nightlife recommendations.
Cholados Nancy — Our final stop for a refreshing treat.
notes: We can adapt to most dietary restrictions, except veganism — just let us know in advance.

tours.title: Galería Alameda Market Tour
tours.description: A full sensory journey through Cali's most iconic market — exotic fruits, local cheeses, flowers, and a peek into the city's esoteric traditions.
tours.highlight: Come hungry! People comment: 'I just ate more fruit than for 1 year back home'
tours.languages: Guides available in English, Spanish & Portuguese
included: Coconut water or coconut/fruit ice cream
itinerary: El Sabor de Doña Teresa — famous for tamales, morcilla, and corn envueltos.

Exotic Fruit Tasting Hall — taste a colorful selection of tropical fruits (mangosteen, cherimoya, anón, curuba, chachairú, gooseberry, loquat, chontaduro, guama, and more depending on season). Includes one sour cocktail made with the most sour fruits of the region.
Cheese Stand — taste fresh cheeses directly from local vendors (cuajada, campesino, costeño).
Coconut Specialty Section — coconut sweets, oils, and local artisanal products.
Flowers Aisle — Colombia is the world's second largest flower exporter; meet heliconia, roses, orchids, and more, straight from the growers.
Witchcraft / Esoteric Zone — stalls where locals buy traditional remedies, amulets, and ritual tools. A unique glimpse into Colombian beliefs.
Souvenir Stands — optional browsing before wrapping up.
notes: We can adapt to most dietary restrictions — just let us know in advance.

tours.title: Coffee Tasting in Cali
tours.description: A guided specialty coffee tasting led by a professional barista — learn, taste, and brew Colombian coffee without leaving the city.
tours.physical_level: Easy (seated experience, no walking, A/C room)
tours.languages: Guides available in English, Spanish & Portuguese
tours.highlight: A hands on coffee experience to delight your senses — learn to taste, smell, and brew like a pro.
included: Learn everything about coffee: from bean to cup, flavor profiles, and brewing methods
not_included: Coffee beans or products to take home (available for purchase)
itinerary: Welcome & Introduction — meet at the designated spot; intro to the world of specialty coffee.
Choose Your Coffee — select your preferred flavor profile based on your taste preferences.
Preparation Demo — the barista prepares each coffee in front of you using different extraction methods.
Guided Tasting — taste, compare, and learn to identify flavor notes, acidity, body, and finish.
Q&A with the barista — ask about processes, regions, and how to recognize great coffee anywhere.
notes: You'll learn: what makes a coffee excellent, why Colombian coffee is world-famous, caffeine vs. over-roasting, flavor profiles, SCA scoring, processing methods (washed, honey, natural), and brewing methods (V60, Chemex, etc.). Don't be afraid to drink 2 cups straight: good coffee is actually healthy.

tours.title: CAFETAL: Coffee Farm Visit in the Andes
tours.description: A full-day journey into Colombia's coffee culture — visit a working farm in Sevilla, pick your own beans, and taste the difference from crop to cup.
tours.highlight: Excellent for travellers with no plans to visit coffee regions — this is a full coffee experience in one day, with a bilingual guide and private transport.
tours.languages: Guides available in English, Spanish & Portuguese
tours.meeting_point: Pickup inside urban Cali (hotel, Airbnb, etc.)
included: Visit a family-run, non-commercial coffee farm
'Coffee collector' experience: pick your own coffee beans, from the tree, with your own hands
Guided local coffee tasting session with a professional barista
Stunning views from local viewpoint 'the balcony of the valley'
not_included: Traditional jeep (jeepeta) ride — available as add-on
Personal purchases, souvenirs, or additional food & drinks
itinerary: Scenic Drive to Sevilla (~3h) — morning departure through mountains and green valleys with a stop for traditional breakfast: arepas, huevos pericos, cheese, and tinto.
Coffee Plantation Experience — arrive at an active coffee farm. Walk through the plantation, learn about the crops, and pick your own coffee beans.
Bean to Cup — follow the complete process: harvesting, drying, roasting, and brewing. Understand the care and craft behind every cup.
Authentic Local Lunch — regional flavors of Valle del Cauca at a local restaurant. Vegetarian and vegan options available.
Guided Coffee Tasting — led by a local barista; taste different methods and discover the notes, aromas, and flavors that make Colombian coffee world-famous.
Balcón del Valle Viewpoint — panoramic views of Sevilla and its coffee-covered hills. Perfect for photos before heading back.
Return to Cali (~3h) — comfortable drive back through the mountains.
notes: Time breakdown: 3h to town · 20min to farm · 1h 20min at farm · 20min back to town for lunch · 1h lunch · 1h cupping · ~25min at the viewpoint · 3h back to Cali
Our destination, Sevilla, is a small town in the coffee region of Colombia. Expect lower temperatures than Cali.

tours.title: ChocoTour: Make Your Own Chocolate Bar on a Cacao Farm
tours.description: What we eat as chocolate is the processed seed of a fruit. Learn everything about it with this Cacao farm visit.
tours.languages: Guides available in English, Spanish & Portuguese
tours.meeting_point: Pickup inside urban Cali (hotel, Airbnb, etc.)
tours.discount: 10% cash COP discount · 5% USD/EUR cash discount
included: Your own DIY chocolate bar to take home
itinerary: Pickup in Cali
Scenic Drive (~1.5h)
Farm Arrival & Tour — cacao trees, pod harvesting demo, fermentation, and drying process.
Hands-On Chocolate Bar Workshop — Design and create your own chocolate bar using fresh cacao and flavorful toppings.
Tasting & Q&A — try local chocolate (from 90% cacao to a commercial chocolate bar) and learn about what really is chocolate.
Return to Cali — drop-off at your accommodation or agreed meeting point.
notes: ~1.5h drive from Cali. Kids and pets welcome (family & pet-friendly). Bring sunscreen and comfortable clothes and shoes.
We're going to a farm, insects are expected.

tours.title: Cali Salsa Tour — Dance, Culture & History
tours.description: Experience the world capital of salsa with dance lessons and cultural immersion.
tours.highlight: Dancing-friendly museums, a local old records shop, and a 2-hour group salsa class at the city's best salsa club.
tours.physical_level: Easy or moderate depending on your willingness to dance
tours.languages: Guides available in English, Spanish & Portuguese
tours.meeting_point: Trumpets monument at the Plazoleta Jairo Varela
included: Visit & explanation of the Niche Trumpets monument
Entry & tour of the Jairo Varela Museum
Visit a local vinyl records shop
Entry & tour of the Salsa Museum
Entry & 2-hour group salsa class at La Topa Tolondra
not_included: Transportation to and from the meeting point
itinerary: Niche Trumpets monument at 3:30pm — meet at the starting point and dive into this musical monument.
Museo Jairo Varela at 4pm — guided visit (entry included); learn about the regional impact of Grupo Niche.
4:30pm - Taxi to the Obrero neighborhood
Vinyl Record Store at 4:50pm — browse and listen to salsa (and other genres); free time to buy records or souvenirs.
Museo de la Salsa in Barrio Obrero 5pm — guided visit by passionate locals (entry included).
6:45pm - Taxi to La Topa Tolondra
Group Salsa Class at Topa Tolondra at 7pm — 2-hour class at the city's best salsa club, suitable for all levels. Private lessons available on request.
Past 9pm - Optional social dancing at La Topa Tolondra — practice your new moves and enjoy the lively atmosphere by yourself
Optional (fridays): Courtesy visit to the Salsa Street.

tours.title: Cristo Rey Viewpoint + Downtown Cali City Tour
tours.description: Get panoramic views from Cristo Rey and explore historic downtown Cali — the best overview of the city in half a day.
tours.highlight: Go to all the must visit spots of Cali with this comprehensive city tour — from the iconic Cristo Rey statue to the charming streets of Barrio San Antonio.
tours.languages: Guides available in English, Spanish & Portuguese
itinerary: Cristo Rey — drive up the mountain to visit the iconic 26m statue (1,440 m altitude). Panoramic views of the city, the Cauca River, and the valley. Outdoor sculptures, lush vegetation, and local snack vendors. Discussion of the hill's spiritual importance and its role during Colombia's internal conflict.
Sebastián de Belalcázar — stop near the statue of Cali's Spanish founder. Additional city views and historical context about his controversial legacy and the pre-existing indigenous cultures.
Parque del Gato de Tejada — visit the famous cat sculpture and learn about its history, symbolism, and the local artist who created it.
Barrio San Antonio — charming colonial neighborhood known for craft shops, colorful streets, and a relaxed vibe. Walk through the park, enjoy city views, and visit the historic church.
Túnel Mundialista — Colombia's longest urban tunnel transformed with creative lighting and art; connects different parts of the city in a unique, modern way.
Loma de la Cruz — open-air craft market where you can find traditional Colombian crafts, jewelry, and local souvenirs.
notes: Our itinerary is a suggestion but we give you the benefit of fully customizable experiences. You may request modifications to suit your preferences.

tours.title: Hummingbird Paradise Tour — Finca Alejandría
tours.description: Visit a hummingbird paradise and observe dozens of species flying freely around you in the cloud forest above Cali.
tours.highlight: Watch hummingbirds in numbers and proximity that you won't find anywhere else in the world — a unique experience for nature lovers and photographers.
tours.physical_level: Easy (seating)(all ages) or moderate with optional mountain walk
tours.languages: Guides available in English, Spanish & Portuguese
itinerary: Pickup at your accommodation in Cali.
Scenic 1h Drive — mountain route into the western Andes (last stretch on an unpaved road).
1h 45min at the Paradise — dozens of hummingbirds at feeders, other forest species at banana feeders, photography opportunities, and relaxation in the mountain climate with welcome coffee.
15-min Local Dessert Stop — on the way back, as well as pet baby goats.
1h Drive Back — drop-off at your accommodation.
notes: Colombia has the highest number of hummingbird species in the world. Unlike zoos or aviaries, this paradise is completely open — birds arrive freely, offering an ethical and genuine wildlife experience.
Bring: light sweater or jacket (the cloud forest can be cool), comfortable shoes if you want to walk.

tours.title: Pance River Waterfall Tour — Chorrera del Indio
tours.description: Escape Cali's heat and swim in the crystal-clear pools of Chorrera del Indio — just minutes from the city.
tours.highlight: Refreshing clean water straight from the Andes — perfect for a half-day escape from the city.
tours.physical_level: Easy stairs down; optional steep climb to second waterfall
tours.languages: Guides available in English, Spanish & Portuguese
not_included: Food or beverages (we can stop on the way if you want to purchase some)
itinerary: Pickup in Cali — 25–75 min transfer depending on your location (last stretch on an unpaved road).
Time at the Waterfall (90-120 min) — swim in natural pools, explore the main Chorrera del Indio waterfall, and hike to the hidden second waterfall (~5-min uphill climb, optional).
Return to Cali — 25-75 min transfer back.
notes: The main waterfall is visible from the parking. It is very accesible even for people with reduced mobility. The second waterfall is a short uphill climb and entirely optional.
Swimming and getting wet is entirely optional. You can enjoy the waterfall and pools without getting wet.
However if you want to get wet, bring: swimwear, towel, water shoes or hiking sandals, change of clothes, plastic bag to store wet items, eco-friendly repellent.
Please make sure to get dry before getting back in the car to avoid discomfort during the drive.

tours.title: Whale Watching in the Colombian Pacific
tours.description: Witness magnificent humpback whales during their annual migration along Colombia's Pacific coast — a full-day adventure from Cali.
tours.highlight: A once-in-a-lifetime experience to see humpback whales in their natural habitat, with a bilingual guide and a local captain.
tours.physical_level: Moderate — long travel day; not suitable for people with reduced mobility or spine problems. Babies not permitted.
tours.languages: Guides available in English, Spanish & Portuguese
included: Fast boat to Bahía Málaga National Natural Park
1h whale watching on a boat with a local captain
Local lunch (seafood is typical, vegetarian and other meat options available)
itinerary: Pickup in Cali (early morning) — 3h transfer through the western Andes to Buenaventura.
Fast Boat on the Pacific Coast (1h) — board a speedboat from the tourist port toward Bahía Málaga Natural National Park.
Whale Watching Tour (1h) — on a boat with a local captain. Watch humpback whales leap, slap their tails, and, if lucky, spot calves. (warning: whales are wild animals, sightings are not guaranteed).
Free Time at the Beach (1h) — swim, relax, snack, or simply listen to the sound of the ocean on a local beach.
Return Boat to Port (1h) — back to Buenaventura.
Return to Cali (late afternoon) — 3h drive back, arriving at night.
notes: Season: July to October. Babies not permitted. Not suitable for people with reduced mobility or spine problems.

What to bring: clothing you can get wet with, light comfortable clothes + light waterproof jacket, sandals or water shoes, sunscreen and repellent, hat, seasickness pills (optional), waterproof phone case, reusable water bottle, light snacks or fruit.
